reviews.title: App might be malicious
reviews.text: Might be a coincidence but since I used the app the following things have happened: my speaker has kept randomly crackling, my phone screen went green and glitched a lot, my phone has been really slow (kicking me out of apps and screen staying black for ages before loading), and my phone went down over ten percent in less than a minute. Additionally, the ads are misleading as it showed dust coming out of the speakers even though that’s not what the app is intended for which lead to me downloading it when I didn’t need it in the first place (for clearing dust from my speakers). Just in case my experience is a result of the app, I’d recommend using an alternative.

reviews.title: Useful idea, unreasonable subscription
reviews.text: The basic idea is handy, but £9.99 per week for a speaker-cleaning/sound-testing app is completely disproportionate to what the app provides. I would happily consider a small one-off purchase for a utility like this, but over £500 a year for these features simply isn’t reasonable.
